description: This file defines the Sphere class within the Goteo project, representing the 'sphere' concept with methods for retrieving, saving, and managing sphere data, as well as associated footprints and icons. It includes static methods for data retrieval, instance methods for managing sphere properties, and uses traits and external classes.

classes.name: Sphere
classes.description: Model class representing a 'sphere' in the Goteo project, encapsulating properties such as name, icon, landing match, order, and methods for CRUD operations, validation, and related data retrieval.

methods.name: getLangFields
methods.description: Returns the fields used for language localization, in this case, ['name'].

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a sphere object by its ID, optionally in a specific language, executing a SQL query to fetch data from the database.

methods.name: getFootprints
methods.description: Fetches footprints associated with the sphere via the Footprint class, based on the sphere's SDGs.

methods.name: getIcon
methods.description: Returns the icon image for the sphere, optionally forcing the use of an asset.

methods.name: setIcon
methods.description: Sets the icon property of the sphere, accepting either an Image instance or a string identifier.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Compatibility method that returns the icon image, aliasing getIcon().

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Fetches all sphere records from the database, optionally filtered by 'landing_match' and language, returning an array of Sphere objects.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and persists the sphere instance to the database, handling potential database errors.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the sphere object, checking for missing 'name' property, and returns true if valid.
